'''Barsoom Boulevard''' was a street in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Crimson Corridor]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Edgar Rice Burroughs|Edgar Rice Burroughs]] gave the planet Mars the name Barsoom in his [[Wikipedia:Barsoom series|Barsoom novels]].
